operating_contract.objective: Review, assess the security impact of, test, and approve every change to production systems before it is deployed, and verify affected controls afterwards.
operating_contract.evidence_requirement: Derived from `github-security` or `gitlab-security` repository and branch-protection settings; impact-analysis, test, and post-change verification records are attested in the change record. A production branch that allows merging without an approving review is an open violation.
